meta.name: comment-checker
meta.description: Use when Codex needs to understand or respond to automatic comment-checker feedback emitted after an edit-like PostToolUse hook.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 理解并回应代码审查的自动反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在编辑代码后处理自动审查反馈。
copy.tagline_en: Understand and respond to automatic code review feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to handle automatic review feedback after editing code.

howto.what: 装上后，每次你成功编辑文件（如修改代码、写入内容）后，它都会自动检查代码注释；如果发现问题，会暂停并提示你先修复或解释被标记的注释。
howto.when: 当编辑类操作成功执行后触发，例如使用 apply_patch、write、edit 等工具修改文件时。

say.text: 检查一下我刚才的改动有没有触发注释警告。
say.note: 触发对最新编辑的注释检查。

say.text: 修复这条被标记的注释，并告诉我原因。
say.note: 让助手处理警告并解释。

say.text: 这个注释检查警告是什么意思？

howto.what_en: After you successfully edit files (e.g., apply_patch, write, edit), it automatically checks code comments; if warnings appear, it pauses and asks you to fix or explain the flagged comments.
howto.when_en: Triggers after successful edit-like tool calls, such as apply_patch, write, edit, and similar.

say_en.text: Check if my recent changes triggered any comment warnings.
say_en.note: Runs comment check on the latest edit.

say_en.text: Fix this flagged comment and tell me why.
say_en.note: Asks the assistant to resolve the warning and explain.

say_en.text: What does this comment-checker warning mean?
say_en.note: Asks for an explanation of the warning.
